speed.notes: 30 feet, fly 120 feet, swim 30 feet; woodland stride;

traits.name: Twisting Tail
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature within reach of the dragon's tail uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using. Effect The dragon makes a tail Strike at the creature with a –2 penalty. If it hits, the dragon disrupts the creature's action.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation, poison); The dragon breathes a toxic cloud that deals 9d6 (9d6) poison damage in a 40-foot cone (DC 25 basic Fortitude save). It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horn Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges its Breath Weapon whenever it scores a critical hit with a Strike.

traits.name: Woodland Stride
traits.text: The green dragon ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from non-magical foliage.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +20 (poison, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d10+8 (2d10+8) piercing plus 2d4 (2d4) poison
